faq.title: Good questions
faq.text: Not covered here? Ask in the community. Creators and businesses answer there.

pricing.a: Every agent is free, one-time, monthly or custom, always in USD. You agree on the final details directly with the creator.

contacts.q: Who can see my email and WhatsApp?
contacts.a: Only signed-in members. Visitors who are not logged in never see your contact details.

ranking.q: How are agents and creators ranked?
ranking.a: Every night, by likes and views from other members. Listing more agents does not move you up.

brief.a: A short description of the agent you need. Budget and deadline are optional, and creators ask questions in the comments.

sell.q: Can I sell my own agent?
sell.a: Yes. Create a listing with screenshots, a demo link and a clear price, and it appears in the marketplace.
